model_annotations.Bulgarian:
Figure 4 displays the mean absolute values of SDPA output before and after applying gating, plotted across 21 layers of the model (from Layer 0 to Layer 20). The y-axis represents the mean absolute value, ranging from 0 to 1, with tick marks at intervals of 0.2. The x-axis is labeled “Layer” and spans integer values from 0 to 20, marked at intervals of 5. Two nearly overlapping lines are shown: a solid black line representing values before gating, and a dashed green line representing values after gating. Both lines remain close to zero for the first 10 layers, then gradually increase, with the post-gating line showing a slightly steeper rise from Layer 15 onward, reaching approximately 0.9 at Layer 20. The caption notes that baseline and post-gating values are similar, which is visually supported by the minimal separation between the two lines.

Figure 5 consists of two side-by-side plots illustrating the sparsity ratio of SDPA output values below specified thresholds after gating, for layers 0 to 20. Both plots share the same x-axis (“Layer”, 0 to 20, marked every 5 layers) and y-axis (“Sparsity Ratio”, 0.0 to 1.0, marked every 0.2). The left plot uses a threshold of 1e-2 and shows three lines: a solid black line for sparsity before gating (avg 0.03), a dashed green line for sparsity after gating (avg 0.44), and a dotted blue line for sparsity after multiplying average gating score with pre-gating hidden states (avg 0.33). The right plot uses a threshold of 1e-3 and similarly displays three lines: solid black (avg 0.03), dashed green (avg 0.126), and dotted blue (avg 0.088). In both plots, all lines start near 1.0 at Layer 0 and decline sharply in the first few layers, then stabilize at low values (below 0.2) from Layer 5 onward. The post-gating lines (dashed green) remain significantly higher than the pre-gating lines across all layers, indicating increased sparsity after gating. The dotted blue lines lie between the other two, suggesting intermediate sparsity when gating scores are combined with pre-gating states.
model_annotations.Chinese: Figure 4 displays the mean absolute values of SDPA output before and after gating across model layers, indicating that baseline and post-gating values are similar; the x-axis represents Layer, ranging from 0 to 20 with linear spacing and integer tick marks at intervals of 5, while the y-axis represents Mean Absolute Value, ranging from 0 to 1 with linear spacing and tick marks at intervals of 0.2; the plot contains two nearly overlapping lines — one solid black line representing pre-gating values and one dashed black line representing post-gating values — both remaining close to zero until layer 15, then rising slightly to approximately 0.1 at layer 20. Figure 5 presents two subplots comparing the sparsity ratio of SDPA output below specified thresholds (1e-2 on the left, 1e-3 on the right) before and after gating, along with sparsity derived from multiplying average gating scores with pre-gating hidden states; in both subplots, the x-axis represents Layer from 0 to 20 with linear spacing and integer tick marks at intervals of 5, while the y-axis represents Sparsity Ratio from 0.0 to 1.0 (left) or 0.0 to 0.8 (right), both with linear spacing and tick marks at intervals of 0.2; the left subplot contains three lines: a solid black line for “sparsity ratio before gate, avg 0.03” starting near 1.0 and declining steeply to ~0.03 by layer 20; a dashed black line for “sparsity ratio after gate, avg 0.44” starting near 0.9 and declining to ~0.44; and a dash-dot black line for “sparsity ratio after average gate, avg 0.33” starting near 0.8 and declining to ~0.33; the right subplot contains corresponding lines: solid black “sparsity ratio before gate, avg 0.126” starting near 0.8 and declining to ~0.126; dashed black “sparsity ratio after gate, avg 0.080” starting near 0.7 and declining to ~0.080; and dash-dot black “sparsity ratio after average gate, avg 0.080” starting near 0.6 and declining to ~0.080.
model_annotations.English: Figure 4 displays the mean absolute values of SDPA output before and after gating across model layers, showing near-identical trends for both conditions; the x-axis represents layer index from 0 to 20 (linear scale), and the y-axis shows mean absolute value ranging from 0 to 1 (linear scale), with both lines (solid for pre-gating, dashed for post-gating) remaining close and gradually increasing with layer depth. Figure 5 presents two subplots comparing sparsity ratios of SDPA output below thresholds 1e-2 (left) and 1e-3 (right) before and after gating, alongside sparsity ratios derived from multiplying average gating scores with pre-gating hidden states; both x-axes span layers 0 to 20 (linear), while y-axes show sparsity ratio from 0.0 to 1.0 (left) and 0.0 to 0.8 (right), with all lines (solid for pre-gating, dashed for post-gating, dash-dot for gated product) sharply declining in early layers and stabilizing at low values thereafter, with post-gating lines consistently lower than pre-gating ones.
model_annotations.German: Figure 4 displays the mean absolute values of SDPA output before and after gating across network layers, showing near-identical trends for both conditions; the x-axis represents layer index ranging from 0 to 20 with linear spacing and integer tick labels, while the y-axis indicates mean absolute value on a linear scale from 0 to 1 with tick intervals of 0.2; two nearly overlapping lines — one solid blue and one dashed green — both exhibit a gradual increase from approximately 0.1 at layer 0 to about 0.9 at layer 20, with minor fluctuations. Figure 5 presents two side-by-side plots illustrating the sparsity ratio of SDPA output values below threshold after gating, with the left panel using threshold 1e-2 and the right panel using 1e-3; both share an x-axis labeled “Layer” spanning 0 to 20 with linear scale and integer ticks, and y-axes labeled “Sparsity Ratio” ranging from 0 to 1 (left) and 0 to 0.8 (right), both linear with tick intervals of 0.2; in the left plot, the solid green line (“sparsity ratio after gate”) starts at 0.44 and declines to ~0.05 by layer 20, while the dashed blue line (“sparsity ratio before gate”) begins at 0.03 and remains near zero; the dotted orange line (“sparsity ratio after average gate”) starts at 0.33 and drops to ~0.03; in the right plot, the solid green line starts at 0.126 and falls to ~0.01, the dashed blue line begins at 0.003 and stays near zero, and the dotted orange line starts at 0.088 and declines to ~0.005.
